reasons: The numerator selects postgresql.tup_fetched with otel_metric_type="gauge", but the definition is a monotonic sum and the dataset only has dataset_types sum. The selector matches no series, and rate() is applied to it, which the rules forbid for non-sum types.

The Datadog request scopes by {$scope,$host}. $host has prefix host, so it should become host_name=~"$host" (host_name is the observed label). The candidate drops it, so it covers all hosts instead of the filtered set.
The metric mapping (rows_fetched to tup_fetched, rows_returned to tup_returned) and the percent-of-total formula structure are reasonable, and the *100 is present in the source.
Both the numerator and denominator should use the same sum selector and rate() treatment, and the $host matcher should be applied to every selector.
